name: Himemiko Iden Jouitai
original_name: 姫巫女 異伝青猪隊
source:
The Shrine Princess Green Boar Unit: it consists of the two shrine maidens Shirabe and Tsutsuji as well as a third creature, the guardian spirit boar Eddy. As they engage in exorcism on the daily, they can't fail but notice that the amount of monsters emerging were steadily decreasing.

Meanwhile, on an internet website called MeTube livestreams are broadcasted where the entire world can become witness of girls wearing shrine maiden clothes getting defiled and gang-raped on camera.

Those monsters which have been plotting in the shadows kept victimizing more and more shrine maidens as well as other girls. 

It doesn't take long until Shirabe and Tsutsuji head out to confront the monsters committing these acts.

Humans who had reached the state of monsters - amalgamations of malice.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ012609.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
神社公主绿野猪部队：由两名巫女白部和筒二以及第三种生物守护灵野猪艾迪组成。当他们每天进行驱魔活动时，他们不可能失败，但会发现怪物的数量正在稳步减少。

与此同时，在一个名为MeTube的网站上进行直播，全世界都可以见证穿着巫女服装的女孩在镜头前被玷污和轮奸。

那些在暗处密谋的魔物，不断地残害着越来越多的巫女以及其他少女。

没过多久，白部和杜二就出发去对抗犯下这些行为的怪物。

人类已经达到了怪物的境界——恶意的融合。
